Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by darula-hpp/shimmer-from-structure (https://github.com/darula-hpp/shimmer-from-structure).
Technology stack: react, vue, angular, svelte.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: README 的 Why This Library? 一节列了传统 shimmer 库的三个麻烦：手写 skeleton 组件、真假两套组件要同步、布局一改骨架就要跟着改。文件树里 docs、example、examples、packages 分开，About 标 MIT license 和 1.1k star，话题标签是 shimmer-effect、skeleton-loading、solidjs、sveltejs 这一串。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
